prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving to outbound load release. Elements: Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): checks paperwork/trailer ID/seals, records damage; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note to Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook: validates arrivals, assigns lane/door, holds risky vehicles outside boundary in recovery); consumes Oversize Load Advisory from Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry); records governance approval, confirms configuration under change control. Inbound Pallet Buffer: staging. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake): sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot, uses Slot Reservation Receipt, reports faults, verifies aisle clear; accepts Crane Service Release Card to return to service after checks. South crane: reduced-speed recovery. East/West Transfer Conveyors; East restarts empty at reduced speed one cycle first. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven): sends Transfer Induction Ticket to Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur: validates destination; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation to WMS; parks vehicles, reports restrictions at shift end); Brasshaven inhibits feed on incomplete restart, holds transfers into isolated area, verifies zones clear at closing. Outbound Dispatch Sorter receives Dispatch Wave Amendment. Outbound Checkweigh Scale sends Gross Weight Variance Slip to Shipping Documentation Desk (reconciles vs shipment record before paperwork). Fire Alarm Panel sends Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice to Safety Zone Controller (maintains exclusion boundary); both may stop movement. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield): produces release card, records service, keeps restrictions visible until cleared. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative; sends amendment, Slot Reservation Receipt; receives snapshot; closes movement record on handoff; records times, reconciles vs plan; closes commissioning action register only when findings have owners/dates. Actors: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (personnel clear, holds, shift reviews, acceptance evidence, emergency change review); spotter; drivers, receiving, yard, maintenance staff. Modes: Normal; Recovery; staged resumption; Commissioning acceptance (approved test plan, representative loads). Requirements: valid receipt; segregate damage; dimensional holds; stale snapshot holds path; no move without WMS release; faulted crane unavailable until checks pass; personnel outside envelope; unexpected event stop; safety checks before production; out-of-tolerance weight resolved before release; handover records/acknowledgement; acceptance withheld for material defects; WMS, fire panel, zone controller, desk/sorter interfaces verified; changes need impact review, approval, record.

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
